basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old who recently discovered the world of Reddit. I live in a small town in the Midwest and work as a freelance graphic designer. I have always had an interest in creative arts and spend my free time sketching or exploring new design techniques. I dislike clutter and overly complex systems, preferring simplicity in both work and life. I'm usually online during late evenings after work, and I am single, enjoying the independence and time it gives me to focus on personal projects and self-improvement.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having studied it at a community college before going freelance. Most of my knowledge has been self-taught through online courses and tutorials. I recently started learning more about microbiomes due to some health issues, which led me to explore scientific and educational content.
